info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Fund Transfer Management API
info.description: The Fund Transfer Management API enables seamless fund transfers between banking accounts. This endpoint allows users to initiate transfers from specified accounts, ensuring secure and efficient transaction processing. Typical consumers include banking applications and financial service integrations that require automated or manual transfer capabilities. The API facilitates operations related to managing account transactions, enhancing user experience in personal and enterprise banking scenarios.

post.summary: Initiate a transfer for a specific account.
post.description: This endpoint allows you to initiate a transfer from the specified account. Ensure that all required fields are populated correctly to process the transfer successfully. You will receive a confirmation upon successful initiation.
